design_family_description: 21 parameters: the whole reciprocal design space, matching the degree-of-freedom count of a Z carrying Schuster & Visser (12) and (13). The default.
objective_norm_description: sum of squared components in the coordinate basis. NOT coordinate invariant, and labelled so deliberately.
observer: laboratory rest observer V = (1,0,0,0), normalised with g_lab
parameterization: 21 parameters in an orthonormal spatial triad adapted to V: 6 symmetric eps, 6 symmetric mu^-1, 9 general zeta, with zeta_adjoint = zeta^T structural
reconstruction: Schuster & Visser (A11), the implementation verified at B1C-S456 to 2.2e-16 on random reciprocal media
scope: Abstract constitutive-design space only. No Maxwell solver, no coils or antennas, no metamaterial unit cells, no dispersion fitting, no experimental control model. Nothing here claims physical realizability of any computed design, and nothing generates measurable gravitational curvature.
